title: lathyrus polymorphus var. incanus
intro: Lathyrus polymorphus var. incanus, commonly known as the hairy pea, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Eastern Europe and Asia, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and act as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus polymorphus var. incanus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
